title: Hazardous Waste Fee on Customer-Pay Work — Insurance Claim Repairs Rate Card Footnote
content:
The hazardous waste fee on customer-pay work under Insurance Claim Repairs is charged once per repair order. For an unrelated-damage addition:

- when a customer charge for an unrelated-damage addition or a part upgrade is **already posted** on the repair order, the addition carries **no hazardous waste fee**;
- when none is posted and the addition is within the touch-up scope of **4.0 labor hours** on its consent, it carries the touch-up hazardous waste fee of **USD 4.95**;
- any other addition carries the hazardous waste fee of **USD 6.95**.

The test looks at customer charges already posted on the repair order's money history — an unrelated-damage charge (which includes a charge for operations the insurer denied) or a customer-pay part upgrade charge — not at consents that are signed but not yet charged.

## Fee table

| Unrelated-damage or part-upgrade customer charge already posted | Labor hours on the consent | Fee |
|---|---|---|
| yes | any | none |
| no | 4.0 or fewer | USD 4.95 |
| no | more than 4.0 | USD 6.95 |

## Footnoted examples (hypothetical repair orders)

- First customer-pay work on the repair order, 3.0 hours: USD 4.95.
- First customer-pay work on the repair order, 4.0 hours: within the touch-up scope, USD 4.95.
- First customer-pay work on the repair order, 4.5 hours: USD 6.95.
- A part upgrade charge has already posted; the new addition is 6.0 hours: no fee.
- A part upgrade consent is signed but its charge has not posted; the new addition is 6.0 hours: USD 6.95.
